correctness.rationale: PASS. For length L, square-grid projected displacements u=L|cos theta|/a, v=L|sin theta|/b, uniform independent translation phases yield conditional independent line counts with means u,v and variances g(u),g(v) where g(t)={t}(1-{t}). Total variance is Var(u+v)+E g(u)+E g(v); angular moments give exact K_ab L^2, negative covariance L^2/(ab)(1/pi-4/pi^2), and mean. g has absolutely uniform Fourier series 1/6-(1/pi^2)sum cos(2pi kt)/k^2; angular averaging gives J0 at each argument and exact constant 1/3. Uniform positive-argument J0 asymptotic at all k>=1 for L large fixed a,b, sum of errors O_ab(L^-3/2), proving the S(L/a),S(L/b) term and signed integer/half-integer limits. Independent quadrature of g against angle and 10,000-term Bessel expansion for four L,a,b samples agreed at numerical tolerance. Short-needle identity and boundary equal grid crossing at zero-probability coincidences checked.
